digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push delivery on async/library/MCP paths
propositions: A rejected tickets-branch push is unobservable on three surfaces (async with detached Popen, library callers with no logging handler, MCP agents reading only tool result) despite the CLI fix in 2a76 naming the rejection reason

The fix records terminal push failures durably in the git dir (not working tree) via a marker file recorded at the single _raise_if_strict choke point, observable via rebar.push_status() and a push_status field on MCP write-tool results

Ten MCP write tools (comment/edit/link/unlink/tag/untag/archive/compact_ticket(s), set_file_impact, set_verify_commands) migrate to a shared WriteAckOut {result, push_status} shape; declare_no_file_impact is excluded as structured_output=False

Marker clears on a successful push; non-failure reasons (push-disabled, async-delivery-unobservable, remote-not-found, invalid-destination) are not recorded to avoid alarm fatigue for supported local-only stores
Limb 4 (reconciler subprocess) is fixed structurally by disk-recorded state independent of logger root, pinned by asserting recording works with no handler on the rebar root
The fix preserves the best-effort contract: push_tickets_branch still returns None, never raises on default path, no CLI exit code changes, unwritable marker does not fail the write
